Definition: Jishi, the name of four Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Ishi is the name of four Israelites, men of Judah and Manasseh. In 1 Chronicles 2:31, the sons of Appaim, Ishi. The fuller story is told on the Ishi, Son of Appaim profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that Ishi is named at all, which tells me God sees individuals, not only crowds.
